_meta.title: wiki-sourced item value corrections (#207)
_meta.note: gear-planner is the single source of truth for WHICH affixes an item has, read structurally. The DDO Wiki is the source of truth for the VALUE. When the two disagree and the wiki's rendered tooltip is unambiguous, the wiki wins and the correction is recorded here with its evidence.
_meta.why_not_gap_corrections: data/seed/gap_corrections.json is ADDITIVE ONLY — it appends affixes gear-planner is missing and deliberately SKIPS any (name, type) the item already carries, so it can never re-introduce the Insightful/Insight double-counts that removal fixed. It therefore cannot correct a value, and widening it to overwrite would put that guard at risk. This file overwrites, and nothing else does.
_meta.stale_guard: Every entry records `from` — the value gear-planner currently carries. The build FAILS if `from` no longer matches, rather than silently pinning a number over a source that has since changed. That is what stops this file from quietly going stale the way the value it corrects did.
_meta.evidence_rule: Every entry carries the verbatim rendered tooltip, not the visible cell. A bundled template hides its numbers in the tooltip; see docs/solutions/conventions/bundled-template-values-live-in-the-tooltip-not-the-cell.md.

Rendered tooltips captured 2026-08-13. Baphomet's and Yeenoghu's Reigns were checked and match; the six ML32 Unholy Defiler artifacts were swept the same day and all match (no entries).

_retired_2026_08_18.why: #374/U4 — the 2026-08-18 gear-planner refresh ADOPTED every correction in this shard. Verified programmatically against the refreshed raw: 16 of 17 affixes now read our wiki-verified `to` value exactly, with ZERO divergences. The seventeenth (Juiblex's Reign / Acid Absorption) is the same story read through its paired type correction — upstream now carries ('Acid Absorption','Insight','15'), adopting both our value AND the retype. The corrections are therefore no-ops, and their staleness guard fired precisely because their premise (upstream is wrong) no longer holds. Retained here as the record of a verify-first win rather than deleted.

_note_619: #619 — the item engraves {{Power Store}}, whose page states 'All spells cast while holding this item receive an enhancement bonus of -10% spell point cost' (https://ddowiki.com/page/Power_Store). gear-planner maps the name to Magical Efficiency correctly and reads it as presence, because the template is called with NO parameters — its magnitude lives in the template body, so a structural read has nothing to read. Tooltip recorded above is the effect's own definition (https://ddowiki.com/page/Magical_Efficiency, 'Magical Efficiency 10%'), which states the type and the magnitude in one line. Harvested 2026-08-30. This file runs BEFORE affix_type_corrections.json in build_dataset.py, so it corrects 1 -> 10 while the type is still Bool; the type shard then records value 10.

Ward Token.name: Holding On
Ward Token.tooltip: Unconscious page, 'Extending unconsciousness range': "Holding On: +40 enhancement bonus" (quoted verbatim, lower-case in the source).
